title: Canonical Client Manager Pattern
purpose: Demonstrate a client-side ES module Manager that mirrors a server Manager, registers notification handlers, wires BgaCards, and calls bga.actions for all server interaction.
context: A client-side ResourceManager class that manages the resource display, handles resource change notifications, and wires the spend-resources action button. The server counterpart is the PHP ResourceManager.
before: dojo.declare('bgagame.resource', null, { setup: function() { dojo.connect(gameui, 'onPlayerAction', this, 'onAction'); }, onResourcesChanged: function(notif) { var qty = notif.args.qty; var el = dojo.byId('resource_' + notif.args.type); el.innerHTML = qty; } });
after: import { BgaCards } from 'ebg/bga-cards'; export class ResourceManager { constructor(private game: GameView, private cards: BgaCards) { this.cards = cards; } setupPromiseNotifications() { this.game.setupPromiseNotifications('resourceManager', [['resourcesChanged', this.notif_resourcesChanged.bind(this)], ['refreshUI', this.notif_refreshUI.bind(this)]]); } notif_resourcesChanged(notif: Notification) { const qty = notif.args.qty; const type = notif.args.type; const el = document.getElementById(`resource_${type}`); if (el) el.textContent = qty; } notif_refreshUI(notif: Notification) { const state = notif.args; Object.entries(state.resources).forEach(([type, qty]) => { const el = document.getElementById(`resource_${type}`); if (el) el.textContent = qty; }); } async spendResources(type: string, qty: number) { await this.game.bga.actions.performAction('spendResources', { resourceType: type, quantity: qty }); } }
explanation: The client Manager mirrors the server Manager structure (CLNT-001). It receives the game view and BgaCards instance via constructor injection (CLNT-002). Notification handlers are named notif_<camelCase> (CLNT-005) and registered in setupPromiseNotifications (CLNT-006). Handlers are idempotent — they set DOM from payload values without assuming current state (CLNT-007). All server actions go through bga.actions.performAction (CLNT-008). DOM is never mutated before server confirmation (CLNT-009). The module uses ES module import/export syntax (CLNT-010). Action buttons are wired through the owning client Manager (CLNT-013). State args from the server are consumed through this Manager (CLNT-014).
common_mistakes: Keeping all client code in a single monolithic file instead of Manager classes
Mutating DOM before the server confirms the action (risks state inconsistency)
Bypassing bga.actions.performAction and calling server endpoints directly
Writing handlers that assume DOM state from previous notifications (non-idempotent)
Using Dojo syntax or legacy widget patterns in new code

annotations.reason: Client Manager class mirrors server Manager.
Constructor receives game view and dependent components.
Handler named notif_resourcesChanged matching server type.
Handler sets DOM from payload without preconditions.
